# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c19 P85](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0085)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is a dark-eyed young woman who anticipates becoming stout by age forty-five.

_Sources: [v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v1 c29 P9](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0009)_

## Personality

Isolde is an entertaining, dark-eyed girl who enjoys sharing gossip and romantic updates about her peers. Self-deprecating regarding her intellect, she worries about being an unintelligent country girl around smarter students. Though easily frightened by confrontation, she is fiercely loyal and maintains enduring friendships.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092), [v1 c29 P9](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0009), [v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)_

## Traits

- Dark-eyed  <sub>[v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v1 c29 P9](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0009)</sub>
- Fearful of anger
- Self-conscious about intellect  <sub>[v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045)</sub>

## Abilities

- Candle-and-cardboard signaling  <sub>[v1 c19 P4](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0004), [v1 c19 P6](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0006)</sub>
- Adept at school geometry  <sub>[v1 c17 P39](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0039)</sub>

## History

Isolde grew up at Pear Hill beside Pembroke's pond and formed a close, imaginative childhood friendship with Nell Harcourt. Together with Nell, she created a candle-and-cardboard signaling method between their windows. During one nighttime prank, Isolde and Nell jumped onto a bed occupied by a visiting Miss Pembroke, which initially sparked anger but ultimately led to a warm friendship between the older visitor and the girls. While attending school under Miss Thorne, Isolde participated in Friday recitations and outperformed Nell in geometry. As she grew older, Isolde attended Regent's Academy alongside friends like Nell, Opal, and Odette. Later, she served as a confidante for Nell, discussing romantic prospects and mutual acquaintances, and eventually planned her upcoming wedding where Hugh Carrow would serve as best man.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 c17 P39](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0039), [v1 c19 P4](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0004), [v1 c19 P85](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0085), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092), [v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)_
